from pathlib import Path
import textwrap, runpy
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
file=p/'task-e95cd3fa.py'
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            mask = {(y-top, x-left) for y, x in cells}
            objects.append((left, top, color, bottom-top+1, right-left+1, mask))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for i, (_, _, color, oh, ow, mask) in enumerate(objects):
        for dy, dx in mask:
            y, x = r0 + dy, c0 + dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        if i + 1 < len(objects):
            r0 += oh - 1
            c0 += ow - 1
    return out
'''
